run_symbolic_math_training: run the symbolic mathematics transformer model training with specified environment and tasks
run_symbolic_math_evaluation: run evaluation only mode on the symbolic mathematics model with beam search decoding
run_symbolic_math_export_data: export training data for symbolic mathematics tasks without running model training
run_symbolic_math_distributed: run multi-GPU distributed training for the symbolic mathematics transformer model
run_symbolic_math_reload: reload a pretrained symbolic mathematics model checkpoint and continue training
